images.prompt: Create a polished game environment background viewed straight into an actual tiny three-dimensional storybook stage. Extra-wide landscape 16:9 shot. The reference shows the lead character's real materials and palette: cream face, matte honey fabric and rounded clay, plum contours, apricot resin clasp. Use that aesthetic in the scenery; depict the place the mischievous little horned demons live, NOT the reference character or any characters. A moonlit tunnel under old plum tree roots, a weathered rounded stone arch with faded gilded carvings around the entrance (opening exactly centered, open warm pink lilac mist at center), crooked plum-coloured felt foliage, tiny amber lantern fruit at either side, a path of worn honey stone leading out toward the viewer, teal and mauve shadows with warm cream lights. Beautiful detailed crafted miniature, tactile delicate fleece/paper clay/gouache, softly directional cinematic volumetric light, foreground shapes at frame edges, negative space through the central 65% for real 3D actors who run towards the camera. Layered depth. Avoid neon, gradients as a substitute for scenery, UI borders, text, logos, people, monsters, visual clutter. Edge-to-edge full bleed game-ready plate.

Square in-game emblem artwork, tightly cropped bust of the opposing horned gate guardian. Paint an atmospheric illustration matching the attached game's indigo and burnt amber persimmon orchard and angular layered matte gouache forms. A dark burgundy hood folded into a strong pointed slightly forward cowl, a deep nearly black plum shadow filling its opening, two widely separated tiny low-contrast dull amber narrow horizontal slits, very small compared to the face. The entire rest of the face plane is uninterrupted dark shadow. Strictly no mouth, teeth, cheeks, nose, eyebrows, pupils, highlights, peach skin or expressions. Two tall bone-colored hooked horns break the top silhouette. Garnet angular cloak, muted copper trim. Frontal three quarter silhouette in the entrance of a gate at twilight. Wide readable shapes, a reserved adversary, a flat warm backlight, no cute doll, no human body, no stitched clothes, no lettering. No large eye glow; the horns and silhouette carry the character. Compose to read at 64px.

A tightly art-directed production texture atlas of exactly 12 collectible magical charm tokens for the Nilo Demon Gate game. The pins all match the handmade velvet character and brass stitching of the reference (reference for style, not for the subject of any pin). Leave 16 percent clear dark plum margin inside each tile to cut each cell as its own square. Precise cell contents, left to right: top row: single honey lightning bolt with two tiny speed trails, two parallel violet shooting comets, long pointed ivory needle piercing a golden hoop, a pink blossom with a little bursting golden center. Middle row: three tiny jewels connected by a zigzag chain of blue sparks, three gold stars orbiting a small ring, blue crescent moon nestled in a lavender cloud, single large golden comet with fiery coral tail. Bottom row: a honey teacup and saucer, a red-and-gold horseshoe magnet pulling a gem, miniature honey-hooded Nilo face with a tiny star, a scalloped teal heraldic shield with one brass star inlay. Consistent scale. Orthographic frontal product photograph, beautifully dimensional forms and clean contours, no character portraits except the eleventh token. Output the whole atlas, four across and three down.
